correctness.rationale: For k=2^m-1,m>=4,h=v2(k!)=2^m-m-1, n>=max(m,h+1),2^n>=n+2+h+v2(a-b), normalized inclusion-exclusion yields quotient congruent F(2)-F(1) mod 2^{n+2} for all a>b>=1. Odd j: q_j=j^{2^n}=1+z_j with v2(z)>=n+2; divided difference binomial tail v2>=2n+3; multiplying by coefficients loses ≤h. Even j: v2((q_j^a-q_j^b)/(a-b))≥2^n-v2(a-b), and explicit second cutoff handles it. Zhao-Zhao-Hong Thm1.3 gives v2(F(2)-F(1))=n+1; therefore exact difference valuation n+1+v2(a-b). Verified independent modular Stirling cases for k=15 and 31 and multipliers 2,3,17,257 (b=1), including large dyadic separation. Assumptions avoid low-index exception.

evidence: Prior two-scale theorem covers n≥10, k=15 only; its scope is not all m; 2014 source explicitly discusses open general two-parameter case.
